results.content: Even in Iowa, Republican candidates for the Senate and governorship are now locked in tight races, a new Suffolk University poll finds − thanks, in part, to dissatisfaction with Donald Trump in a state he carried in three presidential elections. In the governor's race, Democratic state Auditor Rob Sand is leading Republican businessman Zach Lahn by 4 percentage points, 48%-44%. In the Senate race, Republican congresswoman Ashley Hinson is leading Democratic state representative Josh Turek by 4 points, 45%-41%.
